sections.title: Consumer Goods (Procter & Gamble)
sections.description: Procter & Gamble (Cincinnati HQ) — the world's largest consumer goods company, inventor of modern brand management.

blocks.heading: Consumer insight and segmentation ML
paragraphs: ML for P&G's consumer research programs — the consumer insight work that has driven P&G's brand management since the invention of market research in the 1920s is increasingly AI-augmented. P&G's consumer segmentation, purchase behavior analytics, and innovation pipeline targeting use ML at a scale and sophistication that most CPG companies can only aspire to.

blocks.heading: Supply chain resilience ML
paragraphs: ML for P&G's global supply chain — the COVID-era supply chain disruptions exposed vulnerabilities in P&G's lean manufacturing model, accelerating AI investment in supplier risk monitoring, inventory optimization, and demand volatility management for P&G's enormous global manufacturing network.

blocks.heading: Marketing effectiveness analytics
paragraphs: ML for measuring the ROI of P&G's enormous marketing investment — the company spends $7B+ annually on marketing, and the ML that measures which marketing spending drives incremental sales is one of P&G's most commercially significant AI applications.

sections.title: Grocery and Retail Analytics (Kroger)
sections.description: Kroger (Cincinnati HQ) — the US's largest supermarket with 2,700+ stores and $148B+ annual revenue.

blocks.heading: 84.51° loyalty analytics
paragraphs: Kroger's data science subsidiary 84.51° processes data from Kroger's 60+ million loyalty card customers — ML for personalized promotions, product recommendation, and the in-store and digital commerce analytics that Kroger's loyalty program enables. 84.51° is one of the US's most sophisticated retail analytics organizations.

blocks.heading: Fresh food and perishable demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for Kroger's enormously complex fresh food operations — fresh produce, meat, bakery, and deli demand forecasting at the SKU and store level for the most challenging inventory management category in retail.

blocks.heading: Kroger digital commerce analytics
paragraphs: ML for Kroger's growing digital and delivery business — cart abandonment prediction, substitution ML for out-of-stock items, and the last-mile delivery optimization for Kroger's pickup and delivery operations.
